name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-printify
description: FulfillmentAdapter (subsystem 41) backed by Printify's real, current v1 order API (POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders.json to create, POST .../send_to_production.json to actually charge/produce -- Printify's confirmed 'charged only when an order moves to production' billing model, no wallet abstraction) plus real v1 webhooks with confirmed HMAC-SHA256 X-Pfy-Signature verification. Proves fulfillment is genuinely swappable to a second, independent dropship/POD provider, same shape as adapter-printful proved for the first. Public surface is exactly FulfillmentAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/fulfillment only, for the types it implements, plus global fetch as the real HTTP client (no new HTTP dependency introduced -- mirrors adapter-printful's own convention) and Node's built-in crypto for webhook signature verification.
